column1: Addressing Design Note: The project-provided VLAN networks keep their assigned /24 scope boundary. Static infrastructure, network services, and DHCP client ranges are separated using a consistent host-addressing convention. The project-provided 10.20.255.0/24 routed transit allocation is subdivided into /30 point-to-point networks for the routed links between R1, R2, ML-S1, and ML-S2. This provides a unique Layer 3 subnet and two usable interface addresses for each point-to-point connection. R1 serves as the NAT/PAT edge router toward the simulated external network, while R2 supports routed-core connectivity between the multilayer distribution environment and the edge.
